scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --allowJs --checkJs false --jsx react-jsx --moduleResolution bundler --module ESNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck src/types/css.d.ts src/main.tsx
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test src/core/dates/dates.test.ts src/features/reminders/scheduler.test.ts src/features/calendar/upcoming-model.test.ts src/features/command/command.test.ts src/features/search/search-index.test.ts src/features/task-editor/form-state.test.ts src/features/views/model.test.ts
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run env:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run rebuild
scripts.audit: node -e "delete process.env.npm_config_allow_scripts; const result = require('node:child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath, [process.env.npm_execpath, 'audit', '--ignore-scripts', '--audit-level=high'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env }); process.exitCode = result.status ?? 1"
scripts.ci: npm run verify && npm run audit
